summary: Verified homepage matches the clean editorial USP_Homepage_Revised mockup. Tested client-rendered DOM at 1440 desktop and 390 mobile, inspected computed styles, and ran regression on /about, /our-work, /our-work/craft-livelihood, /field-notes, /connect. All critical mockup requirements pass. Only minor nits found (see below).

ui_bugs.issue: On client-side navigation back to '/', the hero heading/tagline render in a very faded light-grey state (looks like a reveal animation that never completes when returning from another route). Hard-refresh of '/' renders correctly dark. Not visible on first load, so low priority but visible to users navigating via SPA.

Spec asked for images to be hidden via display:none. Current implementation keeps display:block but the elements collapse to 0x0 (naturalWidth=0 because the media endpoint returns 401 for those IDs). Visually there is no image shown, but the DOM still fires 4 failed media requests (401). Cleaner fix: apply display:none to .page-home .work-card .photo-frame (or stop rendering the img) to silence 401 console errors.

action_items: Optional: hide .page-home .work-card .photo-frame via display:none (or stop rendering ) to eliminate the 4 x 401 media requests in the console.
Investigate hero-reveal animation state when returning to '/' via client-side navigation — heading/tagline stay in a faded pre-reveal state until next scroll.
critical_code_review_comments: Work-card images still hit the backend media endpoint (401) even though they are visually hidden; prefer removing them from the DOM or display:none the to keep the console clean and avoid unnecessary network calls.

The warm-grey band for 'What Takes Shape' is driven by a sibling wrapper (.hb.hb-text.band) rather than the <section> itself, which makes computed-style assertions on the section element return transparent. Fine visually, but worth consolidating for easier automated verification.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on mockup acceptance criteria (2 low-priority polish items)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Homepage client render reliably triggers with wait_for_function on '.page-home .hero-plain .h1' + body text containing 'WHAT WE INHERIT'. Field Notes approved images render correctly. Four work-card under .photo-frame return 401 but collapse to 0x0 (visually hidden). Possible hero fade-in regression on SPA back-navigation worth watching.
